item.g:title: SHRELL Ultra Shampoo - pH Neutral Car Wash Shampoo | Lavender Breeze | Rich Foam, Spotless Finish
item.g:description: Deep Clean for a Brighter Ride. SHRELL Ultra Shampoo delivers rich, thick foam that lifts dirt and grime effortlessly, leaving a spotless, longer-lasting shine with less effort. Its plant-based, pH-neutral formula is tough on oil and grease but gentle on paint, wax, and coatings. Infused with a refreshing Lavender Breeze fragrance and anti-bacterial cleaning power.
